sources.summary: This week 's coverage brought together a range of news, projects, and announcements from across the architectural world. Stories included conversations ahead of the UIA World Congress 2026, where architects, critics, and award organizers are set to discuss the evolving role of architectural recognition, alongside BIG's proposal for a new university campus in Bentonville , Arkansas. The week also featured updates on major public and cultural projects, from the redevelopment of New York's Penn Station to the ongoing transformation of London's Olympia and the completion of a new cultural center in Dongguan, China . It also marked the passing of Lorcan O'Herlihy, founder of LOHA , whose practice became known for its commitment to housing, urban density, and socially engaged design across Los Angeles and beyond.
